branding.greeting: Hi! I'm Sunrise's virtual assistant. I can answer questions about the practice and help you book a visit.

knowledge.content: Telehealth visits are available for follow-ups and medication reviews. Book a Follow-up and note that you'd like it virtual.
Blood draws are done in-office Mon–Fri before 3pm. Fasting labs are best scheduled in the morning.

compliance.consentText: This assistant helps with scheduling and general practice questions. Please don't share detailed medical history here — only what's needed to book. The information you provide is used to assist you and manage your appointment.
compliance.emergencyNote: If this is a medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest ER.
